key_idea: Just simulate the count-and-describe step on digit strings for up to 100 terms, detecting a repeat with a set.
sketch: Next term = for each digit 0..9 present, its count followed by the digit, in increasing digit order (counts can be multi-digit, e.g. 10 zeros -> '100'). Walk positions 1..100: if the current term equals m print the position; if it was seen before the sequence has cycled and m never appears. If 100 distinct terms pass without a hit, check whether term 101 repeats, otherwise print I'm bored. Numbers are up to 100 digits so keep them as strings; the start value itself is position 1.
